page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c48g1.12xlarge is a GPU-accelerated compute instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running on the KVM hypervisor. The instance features an x86_64 architecture with 24 physical cores and 48 dedicated vCPUs operating at a base frequency of 2.9 GHz, accompanied by 48 MB of L3 cache. Memory capacity is configured at 310.0 GB of RAM, equating to approximately 6.46 GB per vCPU. Graphics and acceleration capabilities are provided by a single NVIDIA Ampere A10 GPU equipped with 24 GB of VRAM. Networking throughput is specified at a baseline of 16 Gbps, while no local instance storage is bundled.

Benchmark testing reveals top-tier performance in AI inference workloads. Small-model LLM inference benchmarks reached 9,711.08 tokens per second during prompt processing and 456.51 tokens per second during text generation. For 7B parameter models, prompt evaluation reached 2,509.43 tokens per second with 90.44 tokens per second during generation, reflecting top 10% bracket capability. In general CPU workloads, the system recorded a PassMark CPU score of 47,330.47 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 15,234.0, representing middle-tier throughput. Notable CPU strengths emerged in cryptographic operations, where PassMark encryption and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression ranked within the top 25%.

In terms of architectural tradeoffs, the configuration pairs a single accelerator with a dense compute and memory footprint, which favors workloads requiring heavy host-side data preparation alongside model execution. The absence of local NVMe storage requires external block storage for persistent data and caching needs. The instance delivers cost efficiency for single-GPU AI inference pipelines, image processing, ray tracing, and compute workloads requiring AVX-512 vector acceleration combined with dedicated GPU compute.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c48g1.12xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance configured with 48 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs (24 physical cores) based on the Intel Xeon 8369B processor clocked at 2.9 GHz, 310.0 GB of system RAM, and a single NVIDIA Ampere A10 GPU with 24 GB of VRAM. Operating on the KVM hypervisor with a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps, the instance does not include bundled local storage. Benchmarks place the system in the top tier for small and medium-scale LLM inference, achieving over 2,500 tokens per second for 7B model prompt processing and over 90 tokens per second for text generation. CPU and memory benchmarks demonstrate average multi-core compute capability alongside strong cryptographic and decompression performance. This instance configuration balances host memory and dedicated GPU acceleration for AI inference pipelines, media rendering, and compute-heavy enterprise tasks.
